omission-audit prompt: for each trigger SOURCE meets, the section must select the check or give an Omitted/None apply reason; where neither, report an omission/add-back finding. A reasoned omission therefore produces nothing. Evidence is the prompt text, not a fixture run.

A missing section is reported with action advisory; audit-trd.js splits advisories off where findings are assembled, so neither reconcile agent sees them and the section is never written into the TRD.

The applicable-omission half is absent by design: fix-audit.js checks only the section's shape, skill names and inputs (the Jest run's 13 tests are all format checks; "a section with none of the three forms" is an empty section, not a silently omitted applicable check).
